title: Bilateral ultrasound-guided transversus abdominis plane block versus local infiltration of surgical wounds for postoperative analgesia in children after laparoscopic procedures: a prospective randomized controlled trial
summary: The aim of the study is to compare two common methods of anesthesia (local infiltration vs. TAP block) after minimally invasive procedures in children.
conditions: Postoperative pain after laparoscopic lower abdominal procedures in children

interventions.name: At the end of the laparoscopic procedure, the trocar wounds are infiltrated with 0.5% lidocaine (1–5 mL per wound, depending on the incision length), taking into account the maximum allowable weight-adapted total dose.
In this group, a bilateral ultrasound-guided TAP block is performed at the end of surgery.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Children after laparoscopic lower abdominal surgery
Exclusion criteria:
Neurologically impaired children
Children with chronic pain syndromes
Children with a known allergy to local anesthetics
